# Harley Street Medical Wellness
> A private longevity clinic in London and Glasgow. We measure before we recommend anything.

## About
Harley Street Medical Wellness is a private clinic with sites in London (1-5 Portpool Lane, EC1N 7UU) and Glasgow (Ingram House, 227 Ingram Street, G1 1DA). Every patient starts with an assessment and a consultation; any treatment is decided individually by a clinician.

## Lifestyle Age Assessment
A free three-minute questionnaire that gives a lifestyle age estimate: a range showing how your habits (smoking, activity, body weight, diet, sleep, alcohol, stress, social connection) compare with large published population studies. It is an educational estimate, not a measurement of biological age and not a medical test. Every figure links to its source, and the method is published at /methodology.

## What we offer
- A free 10-minute consultation to go through your results
- Blood tests
- A saliva-based epigenetic age estimate (a wellness test, not a diagnosis)
- A metabolic health assessment and lifestyle programme
- Further therapies, discussed only in consultation where clinically appropriate
